desc:
Touch a golden field and watch it rot, plant by plant, until nothing is left.

🌾 Touch plants to wither them and earn Life
🍂 Grow your rot tree: touch wider, spread faster, land LUCKY crits
🌕 BLOOD MOON every day at 8:05 PM EDT (00:05 UTC): x2 Life for 20 minutes!
⚡ Unlock 4 rot powers: Swarm, Rot Nova, Blight Bolt and Blight Seed
👥 Rot one huge field with up to 8 friends: it saves, and any of you can carry on
🌻 Clear field after field and bring down each Last Bloom
🎡 Spin the Rot Wheel free every day

👍 Like the game if you want more fields!
